create_lstm_encoder: create an LSTMEncoder with a specified input dimension and hidden size for encoding sequences
create_shared_lstm_encoder: create an LSTMEncoder that shares an existing LSTM cell with a decoder module
run_lstm_encoder_forward: run the LSTMEncoder forward pass on input tensors with shape batch_size, seq_len, input_dim
review_lstm_encoder_init: review the LSTMEncoder constructor to understand input_dim, hidden_dim, num_layers, and shared lstm parameters
summarize_lstm_encoder_forward: summarize the LSTMEncoder forward method that returns hidden state, cell state, and transposed outputs
